title: Crafting station and time gating are inert
reason: Crafting.can_craft compares recipe.station to a _station that ItemsApi.craft sets FROM recipe.station (api.gd:25), so the check is a tautology and never rejects. Every test site repeats the same construction so the suite cannot catch it. _time_required is never passed by any caller and time_required() has no callers. The documented gating in crafting.gd:5 is unimplemented.
next: Give the actor a set of available stations plus a crafting-speed source, pass it into Crafting instead of echoing recipe.station, and assert a wrong station fails in tests

title: data new/edit do not validate referenced ids at write time
reason: A boss loot or recipe input id is written verbatim without checking it resolves. A wave-44 agent typed a misspelt loot id, data new accepted it, and the boss file was only found wrong by the later audit. There is also no --remove-loot and no data delete, so the recovery was to delete and regenerate the file.
next: Resolve every id argument before writing and fail with the nearest matching ids; add data delete and --remove-loot so a bad reference is reversible without regenerating the resource

title: data audit does not run content findings, so percent-on-zero-baseline passes the gate
reason: tools/data.py _audit_command never calls _collect_findings. A percent modifier on a stat whose actor_stats baseline is 0.0 resolves to (0.0+0)*(1+p) = 0.0, i.e. a silent no-op, but 'data audit' reports clean. Only 'data distribution' catches it, via _resolve_zero_baseline_stats(), and distribution is non-gating by default. Found by the wave-49 J14 agent on four items.
next: Call _collect_findings from the audit path (or add the zero-baseline percent check to it) so an inert modifier fails the gate, not just the report

title: cultivation seed tasks skip existing files, so fixing a generator cannot regenerate its output
reason: tools/cultivation/seed.py and seed_systems.py both 'if path.exists(): continue'. Fixing a generator bug then has no effect: the malformed body_cultivation realms had to be deleted by hand and regenerated, and there is no --force. The same shape means a corrected generator silently disagrees with its own committed output.
next: Add --force to both seed tasks so a generator fix can be re-applied to existing resources, and fail loudly when a generator would change existing files without it

title: 156 duplicate display names, many from reusing theme words across waves
reason: A corpus scan finds 156 display names shared by 2+ items across 2748 items. Some are pre-existing (C_/G_ pairs, and materials that legitimately share a name across slots such as 'Iron Ore' on nine ids), but many are this content programme's own: J1_/K1_ frost, J2_/K2_/N5_ ember, J3_/K3_ stone, J4_/K4_ cloud, M3_/N3_ cinder, M11_/N11_ kelp. Each wave picked a fresh-looking theme list without checking earlier waves, so the same theme word recurred and produced identical player-visible names.
next: Allocate theme words from a single global pool checked against all existing display names before each wave, and add a data audit check for duplicate display names scoped so it does not immediately fail on the legacy per-slot material naming

title: 120 qi dantian/meridian catalysts are orphaned: recipe-produced but consumed by nothing and not exempt from the modifier-coverage check
reason: tools/generate_qi_items.py:240-241 emits qi_<realm>_dantian_catalyst and qi_<realm>_meridian_catalyst, but no realm seed declares a dantian_catalyst or meridian_catalyst field (seed fields are only breakthrough_item, training_item, sea_catalyst, strengthening_item, dantian_tier, sea_tier, required_channel_state). _progression_items() exempts an item by finding it referenced in a seed field whose name ends in _item/_catalyst, so these 120 are never exempt: they carry no modifiers (correct for a progression payload per ADR 0009) yet trip 'consumable has 90 items with no modifiers'. Each also has a producing recipe but zero consuming recipes, so a player can craft them for no benefit.
next: Decide with the cultivation programme owner: either add dantian_catalyst/meridian_catalyst seed fields so the payloads are wired and exempt, or stop generating the two catalyst kinds. Do not add stat modifiers to them - ADR 0009 makes a modifierless progression payload correct.

title: 24 legacy chains use a 4-stage shape (base/refined/anointed/perfected) while 334 others use the 5-stage shape
reason: The J1_-J24_ chain family is built as base -> refined -> anointed -> perfected with a 3-value modifier ladder (0.04/0.07/0.14), whereas every other chain in the corpus is base/refined/aged/primed/perfected with 0.03/0.06/0.09/0.13/0.17. A stem-based verifier that assumes the 5-stage shape classifies these 24 as broken (missing aged and primed), which is wrong - they resolve and audit clean. Consequences: their capstones top out at 0.14 instead of 0.17, and the J-chains never got the dual refined/aged alt routes the 5-stage chains have.
next: Decide whether to normalise the J family or declare it a supported second shape. Normalising is NOT possible with the sanctioned tooling: data edit cannot change a recipe's inputs or delete a recipe, so it would mean deleting and recreating 96 items and 72 recipes by hand. If it stays, teach the shape-aware verifiers to detect the 4-stage family explicitly instead of inferring shape from a suffix list.

title: 11 subtypes with <=4 items are deliberate narrative one-offs, not thin categories - do not generate packs for them
reason: currency/shard, currency/mark, misc/tablet, misc/seal, misc/scroll, quest/map, quest/fang, quest/manual, quest/letter, quest/shard each hold exactly 1 item, and quest/token holds 3. They are hand-authored seed props, each pinned to a specific narrative source: quest_ancient_map is quest:main_03, quest_beast_fang is quest:side_02, quest_cultivation_manual is quest:side_04, quest_sealed_letter is quest:main_01, quest_spirit_stone_shard is quest:side_03, curr_chaos_shard drops from boss:E10_dao_warden, curr_primordial_mark from boss:E10_transcendent_oracle, and currency_seal_token / currency_tribute_scroll both sit on quest:A37_route. They are the unique reward of one quest or boss, so a single item is the intended count. This answers a question left open for five waves: they are NOT miscategorisations and must not be 'fixed'.
next: When a thin-subtype scan or a data-distribution report ranks these at the bottom, ignore them. Any future thin-subtype targeting must exclude subtypes whose items carry a hard quest:<id> or boss:<id> reference, since that is the signature of a narrative one-off. Only quest/token (3 items, no pinned source) is a genuine candidate for growth.

title: The material-pack brief's 'starved subtypes' list is stale prose - do not target it, and prefer genuinely NEW subtypes instead
source: wave 71 E13 agent flag, confirmed by disk measurement
reason: chaos-content-brief-material61.md tells agents to draw from a fixed set of eight starved subtypes (tablet, scroll, gemstone, ingot, fragment, core, filament, bone). Measured on disk, all eight already hold 71-112 items each (tablet 88, scroll 90, gemstone 112, ingot 112, fragment 91, core 94, filament 71, bone 107) - none is starved. A wave-71 agent read that prose, noticed its assigned subtype was not on the list, and correctly reported the pack would not relieve the gap it named. It was following the right instinct against a wrong instruction: the pack's actual job was to refill the unconsumed gather pool, which it did, and it additionally took material subtypes from 15 to 19 by using four genuinely new ones (bark, horn, pearl, gut).
next: When cutting a material pack, prefer a subtype that does not exist yet over a thin one that does - a new subtype raises the subtype count, a thin one only adds depth. Ignore any hardcoded subtype list in the brief prose; measure thinness from disk with tools data distribution or a direct count. The same brief also has a second stale claim: it says lines are --sources gather while some per-line task files say quest. Where the two disagree the per-line task file wins, and only gather puts a material into the unconsumed pool that chains draw from.
